newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka rupee flat in low trading.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka rupee flat in low trading.

text.p: The Sri Lankan rupee was trading at near its previous closing levels against the dollar on Monday mostly on lack of commercial demand for the greenback, dealers said.
They said the Central Bank pushed the rupee up by one local cent, fixing the buying and selling rate at 58.4323 and 59.6127 respectively.
"There is not much trading in the market. The dollar is at the lower end," said a foreign bank dealer.
He said the market was unlikely to move much on lack of demand for dollars, which was mixed in the international markets.
At 0630 GMT the rupee was at 58.47 against its previous close of 58.45 on Thursday. The foreign exchange market was closed on Friday due to the Buddhist religious holiday.
Overnight call money, which opened at 11 percent fell to 10.75 before recovering to 11 in a liquid market, dealers said.
Call money closed at 11.75 percent on Thursday.
